rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Verifies that livestock inventory StatVars have observations within 1 year of current year and all other survey StatVars are within 2 years of current year to account for seasonal release lag

params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_FarmInventory_(CattleAndCalves|BeefCows|MilkCows|SheepAndLambs)$') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
